notes.v1_03: Magnifier: Tint the lens glass a pale, clear cool blue-grey in place of the background green, with one soft curved reflection along its upper left. Make the right side of the metal ring and the underside of the red handle slightly darker, and add a soft faint shadow of the magnifier on the rings. Keep the magnifier, the green ring backdrop and the view.
notes.v1_06: Evidence Bag (tennis pair): Replace the olive stitched felt with bright, warm honey-orange wood with a few broad, soft grain bands. Paint the plastic as a smooth, slightly glossy clear pouch with two or three broad soft highlights in place of the crumpled wrinkles. Give the bag a soft, slightly darker shadow on the wood toward the lower right. Keep the bag, the blue zip, the gold ring, the label and the view.
notes.v1_08: Trench Coat: Paint the wall a soft cool teal-grey in place of the mustard yellow. Make the coat's right sleeve, the right side of the body and the folds under the belt slightly darker warm brown. Give the cloth a smooth, soft matte gabardine look. Keep the coat, the hook, the window, the plant, the drawer and the view.
notes.v1_04: Fedora (fan pair): Paint the felt as one even, smooth, soft matte orange with no blotches, slightly deeper orange on the right of the crown and under the brim. Make the purple waves slightly lighter and brighter. Keep the hat, the green band, the wave backdrop and the view.
notes.v1_07: Steel Safe: Paint the safe a slightly lighter mid royal blue in crisp, smooth satin paint, with soft bright highlights along the top edges and a gently darker right side. Add a soft light glow on the pink wall behind the safe. Keep the gold dial, the handle, the hinges, the feet, the magenta backdrop and the view.
notes.v1_05: Police Badge: Give the black leather a soft cool blue-grey sheen on the left halves of both flaps. Give the gold badge one broad, soft shine in place of the hard white hot spots. Add a soft, slightly darker shadow on the wood along the wallet's right and bottom edges. Keep the wallet, the badge, the ID card, the wood and the view.
notes.v1_10: Handcuffs: Give the steel a soft satin finish with one broad highlight per ring and deeper cool blue-grey shading on the inner curves. Make the shadow under the cuffs slightly darker and firmer. Make the red backdrop a slightly deeper, even coral red out to the corners. Keep the cuffs, the chain, the locks and the view.
